title: Quadratic Equations一元二次方程

slides.h:
🎯 Quadratic Equations一元二次方程

Solving by factoring & square roots因式分解法与直接开平方法

If two numbers multiply to zero, one of them must be zero. That single fact solves most quadratic equations on your test in two lines.两个数相乘等于零，其中至少一个是零。就凭这一条，考卷上大多数一元二次方程两行就能解完。

Difficulty难度 ●○○
⏱ 25 min · ★ essential必会

🔑 Must know必须记住 · Solving by factoring & square roots因式分解法与直接开平方法
  1. Zero product: get 0 on one side FIRST, then set each factor =0.零积法则：先让一边等于 0，再令每个因式 =0。
  2. (…)2=k: take ±k​; k<0 → no real solution.(…)2=k：开方取 ±k​；k<0 → 无实数解。
  3. Never divide by x: factor it out, or the root x=0 is lost.不要两边除以 x：把 x 提出来，否则丢掉根 x=0。
AB=0 ⇒ A=0 or B=0
(x−p)2=k ⇒ x=p±k​(k≥0)

🧗 The hard part难点 · Solving by factoring & square roots因式分解法与直接开平方法

Making it =0 before factoring分解前先化成 =0

A factored left side looks finished, so students set each bracket equal to the right side.左边已经是因式形式，看着像做完了，于是把每个括号设成等于右边的数。

  1. (x+1)(x−4)=6: right side =0, so stop(x+1)(x−4)=6：右边不是 0，先别拆
  2. x2−3x−4−6=0⇒x2−3x−10=0
  3. (x−5)(x+2)=0⇒x=5, −2
  4. Check x=5: (6)(1)=6验 x=5：(6)(1)=6
Try试一试
Solve (x+1)(x−4)=6.解 (x+1)(x−4)=6。
Answer答案
x=5 or x=−2x=5 或 x=−2

⚠️ Traps & tip陷阱与提示 · Solving by factoring & square roots因式分解法与直接开平方法
  • x(x−3)=10⇒x=10 or x−3=10 → expand: x2−3x−10=0, x=5,−2.x(x−3)=10⇒x=10 或 x−3=10 → 先展开：x2−3x−10=0，x=5,−2。
  • x2=49⇒x=7 → x=±7.x2=49⇒x=7 → 应为 x=±7。
🎯
Already "square = number"? Square-root directly; never expand it.已经是「平方 = 数」？直接开方，别展开。

🎯 Quadratic Equations一元二次方程

Completing the square配方法

x2+8x−3=0 will not factor. Turn the left side into a perfect square, and the square root method finishes it in one step.x2+8x−3=0 分解不了。把左边凑成完全平方，再用直接开平方法，一步就解完。

Difficulty难度 ●●○
⏱ 35 min · ★ essential必会

🔑 Must know必须记住 · Completing the square配方法
  1. Make a=1 → move c → add (2b​)2 to BOTH sides → take ± ​.化 a=1 → 移常数 → 两边都加 (2b​)2 → 开方取 ±。
  2. Equation: add to both sides. Vertex form of a function: add AND subtract on one side.解方程：两边同加。化函数顶点式：同一边加了再减。
  3. Right side negative after completing → no real roots; stop.配方后右边为负 → 无实数根，可以停。
x2+bx=k ⇒ (x+2b​)2=k+(2b​)2

🧗 The hard part难点 · Completing the square配方法

Completing the square with fractions带分数的配方

Odd b (or dividing by a) forces fractions, and halving or squaring them goes wrong.b 为奇数（或除以 a 后）必出分数，取一半、平方时容易错。

  1. 2x2+6x−1=0⇒x2+3x=21​
  2. Half of 3 is 23​; square: 49​3 的一半是 23​，平方得 49​
  3. (x+23​)2=21​+49​=411​
  4. x=−23​±211​​=2−3±11​​
Try试一试
Solve x2+5x+2=0 by completing the square.用配方法解 x2+5x+2=0。
Answer答案
x=2−5±17​​

⚠️ Traps & tip陷阱与提示 · Completing the square配方法
  • x2+6x=2: x2+6x+9=2 → add to both sides: =11.x2+6x=2：写成 x2+6x+9=2 → 两边都加：=11。
  • 2x2+8x=3: add 16 → divide by 2 first, then add 4 to both sides.2x2+8x=3：加 16 → 先除以 2，再两边加 4。
🎯
Odd b or a=1 means fractions; if the method is not required, use the formula.b 为奇数或 a=1 会出分数；题目没规定方法就用求根公式。

🎯 Quadratic Equations一元二次方程

The quadratic formula求根公式

Some quadratics just will not factor — like 2x2−3x−4=0. The quadratic formula solves every single one, no guessing.有些二次方程怎么也分解不了，比如 2x2−3x−4=0。求根公式能解所有二次方程，不用碰运气。

Difficulty难度 ●○○
⏱ 30 min · ★ essential必会

🔑 Must know必须记住 · The quadratic formula求根公式
  1. x=2a−b±b2−4ac​​, only after the equation is ax2+bx+c=0.x=2a−b±b2−4ac​​，先化成 ax2+bx+c=0 再用。
  2. Read a,b,c with their signs; b2 is never negative.a,b,c 连符号一起读；b2 永远不是负数。
  3. Simplify the radical, then divide EVERY term on top by 2a.先化简根式，再把分子每一项都除以 2a。
x=2a−b±b2−4ac​​

🧗 The hard part难点 · The quadratic formula求根公式

Simplifying the answer fully把答案化到最简

Simplifying the radical and cancelling a common factor must happen in that order.化简根式和约公因数要按顺序来。

  1. x2−6x−3=0: D=36+12=48x2−6x−3=0：D=36+12=48
  2. 48​=43​
  3. x=26±43​​=3±23​
Try试一试
Solve 2x2+4x−1=0 (exact).解 2x2+4x−1=0（精确值）。
Answer答案
x=2−2±6​​

⚠️ Traps & tip陷阱与提示 · The quadratic formula求根公式
  • 24±23​​=4±3​ → 2±3​.24±23​​=4±3​ → 应为 2±3​。
  • x2=5x−2 read as c=−2 → move first: x2−5x+2=0, c=2.x2=5x−2 读成 c=−2 → 先移项：x2−5x+2=0，c=2。
🎯
Write b2−4ac on its own line first: it catches sign errors and tells you if roots exist.先单独算一行 b2−4ac：能抓符号错，也能先知道有没有根。

🎯 Quadratic Equations一元二次方程

The discriminant判别式

Can a ball thrown at this speed ever reach 25 m? You can answer yes or no with one number — without solving anything.用这个速度抛出的球能达到 25 米高吗？只算一个数就能回答，根本不用解方程。

Difficulty难度 ●●○
⏱ 30 min · ★ essential必会

🔑 Must know必须记住 · The discriminant判别式
  1. D=b2−4ac: D>0 two roots, D=0 one (double) root, D<0 no real roots.D=b2−4ac：D>0 两个根，D=0 一个（重）根，D<0 无实数根。
  2. D a perfect square → rational roots → it factors.D 是完全平方数 → 有理根 → 能因式分解。
  3. Unknown k: write D in k, set =0, >0 or <0, solve.含 k：用 k 写出 D，令 =0、>0 或 <0，解出 k。
D=b2−4ac

🧗 The hard part难点 · The discriminant判别式

D>0 or D<0 with k: a quadratic inequality含 k 的 D>0 或 D<0：二次不等式

When k is in b, D is quadratic in k, so the condition is an inequality, not one value.k 在 b 里时，D 是 k 的二次式，条件变成不等式，答案不是一个数。

  1. x2+kx+25=0, two roots: D=k2−100>0x2+kx+25=0 有两个根：D=k2−100>0
  2. Zeros of k2−100: k=±10k2−100 的零点：k=±10
  3. Opens up, positive outside: k<−10 or k>10开口向上，两侧为正：k<−10 或 k>10
Try试一试
For which k does x2+kx+25=0 have two different real roots?k 取何值时 x2+kx+25=0 有两个不等实数根？
Answer答案
k<−10 or k>10k<−10 或 k>10

⚠️ Traps & tip陷阱与提示 · The discriminant判别式
  • D=0 means "no solution" → it means exactly one real root.D=0 当成「无解」→ 实际是恰有一个实数根。
  • x2+(k+1)x+4: b=k → b=k+1; square the whole bracket.x2+(k+1)x+4：b=k → 应为 b=k+1，整个括号一起平方。
🎯
"Touches the x-axis", "tangent", "equal roots" all mean D=0.「与 x 轴相切」「切线」「两等根」都表示 D=0。

🎯 Quadratic Equations一元二次方程

Choosing a method & word problems选方法与应用题

A picture frame, a path around a garden, a ball in the air — the equation is the easy part once you know which method to grab and which answer to throw away.相框、花园四周的小路、空中的球——只要知道该用哪种方法、该舍掉哪个根，方程本身就不难。

Difficulty难度 ●●●
⏱ 45 min · ★ essential必会

🔑 Must know必须记住 · Choosing a method & word problems选方法与应用题
  1. Variable = what is asked; equation from area, Pythagoras or "height = value".设所求为未知数；由面积、勾股定理或「高度 = 某值」列方程。
  2. A frame or path of width x adds 2x to each dimension.宽为 x 的边框或小路，使每个方向的长度都增加 2x。
  3. Solve fully, then reject roots that make no sense (say why); keep both if both fit.先完整解出，再舍去不合理的根（写出理由）；两个都合理就都保留。
x=2a−b±b2−4ac​​
a2+b2=c2

🧗 The hard part难点 · Choosing a method & word problems选方法与应用题

Turning words into one equation把文字变成一个方程

The algebra is easy; choosing the variable and the equation is the real work.代数不难；难在设未知数和列方程。

  1. w = width, length =w+4w = 宽，长 =w+4
  2. Diagonal 20: w2+(w+4)2=400对角线 20：w2+(w+4)2=400
  3. 2w2+8w−384=0⇒(w+16)(w−12)=0
  4. Reject w=−16 (length >0): 12 by 16舍去 w=−16（长度为正）：12 × 16
Try试一试
A rectangle has a diagonal of 20 cm, and its length is 4 cm more than its width. Find its dimensions.一个矩形对角线长 20 cm，长比宽多 4 cm。求长和宽。
Answer答案
12 cm by 16 cm宽 12 cm，长 16 cm

⚠️ Traps & tip陷阱与提示 · Choosing a method & word problems选方法与应用题
  • Border of width x: (10+x)(6+x) → (10+2x)(6+2x).宽为 x 的边框：(10+x)(6+x) → 应为 (10+2x)(6+2x)。
  • Ball at a height at t=1 and t=3: giving one → give both (up and down).小球在 t=1 和 t=3 都到某高度：只答一个 → 两个都要（上升和下降）。
🎯
Perfect square → roots; factorable → factor; otherwise or decimals wanted → formula.完全平方 → 开方；能分解 → 分解；否则或要小数 → 公式。

quiz.q: An 8 cm by 12 cm photo gets a border of uniform width x cm. Photo and border together cover 192 cm². Which equation models this?一张 8 cm × 12 cm 的照片四周加宽度为 x cm 的均匀边框，照片连边框共 192 cm²。哪个方程正确？
opts: (8+x)(12+x)=192
(8+2x)(12+2x)=192
(8+2x)(12+2x)=192−96
2(8+2x)+2(12+2x)=192
quiz.hint: Sketch it: the border sits on both sides of each dimension.画个图：每个方向两侧都有边框。
quiz.why: Correct: new dimensions 8+2x and 12+2x; their product is the total area (x=2).正确：新尺寸 8+2x 和 12+2x，乘积就是总面积（x=2）。
whys: Added the border once; it is on both sides, so each dimension grows by 2x.边框只加了一次；两侧都有，每个方向加 2x。
Correct: new dimensions 8+2x and 12+2x; their product is the total area (x=2).正确：新尺寸 8+2x 和 12+2x，乘积就是总面积（x=2）。
192 is already the total, so do not subtract the photo area from it.192 已经是总面积，不能再减去照片面积。
Used perimeter; the question gives an area.用了周长；题目给的是面积。

quiz.hint: Set h(t)=22, move everything to one side, and keep every root that fits the flight.令 h(t)=22，移到一边，保留所有在飞行时间内的根。

whys: Correct: −5t2+25t−20=0⇒t2−5t+4=0⇒t=1,4; once going up, once coming down.正确：−5t2+25t−20=0⇒t2−5t+4=0⇒t=1,4；上升一次、下降一次。
